app.subtitle: Intelligent Drug Interaction & Toxicity Simulator
app.disclaimer: This application is an educational decision-support demo. It must not be used for diagnosis, prescribing, or treatment decisions.

sidebar.current_medications_help: Separate medications with commas. Brand names are also supported (e.g. Coumadin).
sidebar.openfda_help: Retrieves FDA label information for the new medication, including warnings and interaction text.
sidebar.gemini_help: Generates an AI-assisted clinical summary in the selected language. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.
sidebar.rxnorm_missing: RxNorm database was not found. You can build it with `scripts/build_rxnorm_db.py`; the application still works without it.

prescription.new_medication_help: Enter an active ingredient or brand name (e.g. warfarin or Coumadin).
prescription.rxnorm_brand: RxNorm: {name} is a brand name — active ingredient: {ingredients} (RXCUI {rxcui})
prescription.rxnorm_suggestions: No exact RxNorm match. Did you mean one of these? {suggestions}
prescription.rxnorm_no_match: No RxNorm match was found; the medication name will be used as entered.

analysis.error: The analysis could not be completed. Check the inputs and try again.
analysis.error_hint: If the issue persists, disable external data sources and try offline mode.
analysis.ai_model_note: Model: {model} · This summary is for informational purposes only.
analysis.ai_unavailable: The AI summary could not be generated due to an API-key or connection issue. The rule-based result remains available.
analysis.idle: Review the patient information and press Analyze to start the assessment.

findings.none: No explicit risk findings were detected.

drug_info.unavailable: Drug information could not be collected.
drug_info.openfda_missing: openFDA label data was not found or is disabled.
